0.q: TmHKT1;5-A encodes a high-affinity (for a HKT), Na+-specific transporter located on the plasma membrane... ideally localized to withdraw Na+ from the xylem and reduce transport of Na+ to leaves.
the sodium transporters TmHKT1;5-A and TaHKT1;5-D, from Triticum monoccocum and Triticum aestivum, are encoded by genes underlying the major shoot Na+-exclusion loci Nax1 and Kna1, respectively.
both TmHKT1;5‐A and TaHKT1;5‐D encode dual (high and low) affinity Na+‐transporters... contribute towards the improvements in shoot Na+‐exclusion and crop plant salt tolerance
An HKT1;5-like gene was proposed as the candidate for both Nax2 and Kna1 (Byrt et al. 2007).

When TmHKT1;5-A (Nax2 locus) from Triticum monococcum was introduced into a commercial durum wheat, a reduction in leaf Na+ concentration and a 25% improvement in grain yield in the field were observed.

1.q: Fine mapping of the Nax1 locus indicated that the candidate gene was TmHKT1;4-A2, which likely encodes for a Na+-specific transporter located on the plasma membrane of cells surrounding xylem vessels.

2.q: TmHKT1;5-A encodes a high-affinity (for a HKT), Na+-specific transporter located on the plasma membrane... present within cells adjacent to the xylem vessels of wheat roots containing the Nax2 locus and this results in at least a 50% reduction in Na+ accumulation within seedling leaves.
